release_notes: Cage/chapter visibility and localization fixes. FIXES: the Cage Vis/Hid state now sticks through Expansion and Sculpt - hiding a cage no longer gets silently undone and the button matches the cage; switching chapters inside Export Settings now keeps the new chapter's LP hidden instead of showing it; the whole Cage_BG hierarchy stays hidden outside Export Settings (re-checked on chapter switch and on HP/LP Visible). VISIBILITY: the HP Visible and LP Visible buttons now reveal meshes that were hidden at their own level inside subgroups and so were previously unreachable from the tool; clicking a chapter that was hidden via its Eye flag now reveals it and turns the flag back on. LOCALIZATION: completed the Japanese and Chinese translations - Cage Settings and Export panels, status messages and dialogs, and the last English tooltips (cage tool buttons, Cage Vis/Hid).
